# ABC (Australian Broadcasting Corporation)

> > Australia's national public broadcaster providing news, television, radio, and digital content services across the nation and internationally.

The ABC is Australia's most trusted source of independent news and information, operating multiple television channels, radio networks, and digital platforms. The organization also engages in international development through ABC International Development (ABCID) and produces flagship programs like ABC NEWS and 7.30.
